name: io.github.omerfsen/nvidia-nvsentinel-mcp
title: NVSentinel Lab
description: Test NVIDIA NVSentinel on a kind lab: read its state and inject faults into a simulated GPU.

environmentVariables.name: NVSENTINEL_MCP_KUBECONFIG
environmentVariables.description: The one kubeconfig it uses, private to you. Default in the image: /kube/config.

environmentVariables.name: NVSENTINEL_MCP_ALLOW_CHANGES
environmentVariables.description: Exactly true allows the change tools, on a kind cluster only. Off when unset.

environmentVariables.name: NVSENTINEL_MCP_LAB_CONTEXT
environmentVariables.description: The kubeconfig context changes need. Must start with kind-. Default kind-nvsentinel-lab.
